title: Warehouse shipment JSON
prompt:
Return one JSON object and nothing else for shipment SHP-100. The carrier is Northwind. The status is in_transit.

The object must include the keys shipmentId, carrier, and status. status must be one of booked, in_transit, or delivered. Do not include a phone number or a 10-digit number.
constraints: status is booked, in_transit, or delivered
